{{Top|leg}}
A '''Gorskin''' was a type of giant sea [[Turtle/Legends|turtle]] that lived on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]].

==Biology==
Gorskins were covered in plates and had bony heads. They looked vaguely similar to the [[kilassin]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], which led some anthropologists to believe that the two species were related.

==Behind the scenes==
Gorskins were first mentioned in the ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'', where they were referred to as "Giant sea turtles."
